name: Docker Learn
subject: Docker & DevOps
description: Learn Docker and DevOps in five-minute bites: containers, images, Dockerfiles, Compose, multi-stage builds, CI/CD, security, and orchestration.

featuredCode.code:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN apk add --no-cache nodejs
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install --omit=dev
COPY src/ ./src/
USER node
CMD ["node", "src/index.js"]

quizPreview.prompt: What is the primary difference between a container and a virtual machine?
options: A container runs a complete guest operating system and kernel
A container shares the host kernel as an isolated process
A container requires dedicated hypervisor hardware virtualization
A virtual machine cannot run Linux operating systems
